record.question: In "Anemia Mukt Bharat operational guideline 2018" What is the recommended oral iron and folic acid supplementation in pregnancy by The Ministries of Health, Govt of India?
options: Daily 100mg of elemental iron with 500 mg of folic acid from 14 weeks onwards for 100 days
60 mg of elemental iron with 400 mg of folic acid daily for latter 6 months of pregnancy till 3 months post-partum
60 mg of elemental iron plus 500 mg of folic acid daily starting from 2nd trimester for 180 days and to be continued for 180 days after delivery
100 mg of elemental iron plus 400 mg of folic acid daily for latter 6 months of pregnancy till 6 months post-partum
